title: Algebraic independence of periods of Anderson modules and their hyperderivatives
summary: Transcendence questions of periods and quasi-periods of Anderson modules, as well as the hyperderivatives thereof, are of major interest in number theory over function fields. In the case of Drinfeld modules, this question was answered by the second author. In this paper, we show that these results hold for general Anderson $t$-modules under certain assumptions on their Galois representations.
